title: Structural enforcement of the PROP-076 close-record lint via git pre-push hook (+ API-path lint guard)
author: tinker
source_finding: tinker report-2026-06-06T05-04.json [major] finding: 3 decider pushes in 2 days landed close-records violating PROP-059 discipline despite the PROP-076 lint gate being deployed
problem: PROP-076 deployed lint-close-records.js with a prompt-level invocation in decider-patches-and-selfapply.md (pre-push gate block). Three pushes bypassed it: 38deae25 (2026-06-04T13:18Z, ISS-2571..2577), f52d3ae0 (2026-06-05T01:16Z, ISS-2579/2580), 196dde8d (2026-06-05T09:13Z, ISS-2587). All 10 violating entries match the lint filter exactly (verified by replay), so the lint cannot have executed and exited 0.

evidence: Lint script present in all 3 commit trees; md5 43d33c4953f5a86a28c416445aa99916 identical to current — the filter logic flags all 10 violating entries when replayed against each commit vs its parent (7+2+1 violations confirmed)
Prompt gate block present in all 3 commit trees (4 lint-close-records mentions each) — the gate text existed; it was not executed

All 3 commits authored+committed as steve <russelst@melrosecastle.com> (the canonical clone-setup git config), i.e. pushed via the normal git path, not push-via-api.js (which would carry the PAT identity since it sets no author)
Zero PRE-PUSH GATE / lint output traces in latest-decider-summary.txt at any of the 3 commits

The canonical block wraps the lint in an unmasked "if ! node ...; then exit 1" — had it run, the push would have aborted. Landing on origin/main therefore implies non-execution, ruling out H3 (exit-code masking)
H2 (conditional hole) ruled out: the only conditional is "[ -f monitor/scripts/lint-close-records.js ]" and the file existed in all 3 worktrees

Partial-compliance signature in 196dde8d (ISS-2586 HAS verification_pattern, sibling ISS-2587 written in the same run does not) — classic per-record prompt drift while the mechanical gate never ran; same bug class as the PROP-066..074 Step-4c skip saga

proposal: Two-layer structural fix, per DIRECTIVE-20260606-001 design (a): (1) install a 3-line pre-push git hook at decider clone setup (immediately after "cd $CLONE" in decider-patches-and-selfapply.md step 0) that execs lint-close-records.js via "git rev-parse --show-toplevel" — enforced by git itself on EVERY push from the clone, regardless of which prompt blocks the LLM executed; the hook is a wrapper (not a copy) so lint-script updates never drift; (2) add a lint guard inside push-via-api.js (the PROP-050 API fallback path, which never runs "git push" and therefore bypasses git hooks) firing whenever monitor/decisions/closed-issues.json is among --files. The existing prompt-level invocation is retained as layer 1 (earlier, friendlier failure). --no-verify is declared FORBIDDEN in the prompt comment.
residual_risk: An improvising LLM could still route around both layers via the universal-pusher FUSE rescue (copy violating closed-issues.json to FUSE; workspace-sync pushes it within ~1h, ungated). Explicitly out of scope per directive non-goals (no lint surfaces on workspace-sync). Mitigation: integrity 7h daily audit remains the layer-3 detector; post-deployment canary watches the next 2-3 decider runs. If a 4th bypass appears via the FUSE-rescue shape, escalate immediately and consider a follow-up PROP gating workspace-sync universal-pusher on closed-issues.json.

verification_simulation.method: For each bypass commit c: bare origin seeded with the parent commit closed-issues.json; work clone with hook installed exactly per the new prompt block; replay commit c closed-issues.json; attempt git push.
results: 38deae25: hook fired, lint FAIL (7 violations ISS-2571..2577), push refused, origin/main unchanged
f52d3ae0: hook fired, lint FAIL (2 violations ISS-2579/2580), push refused, origin/main unchanged
196dde8d: hook fired, lint FAIL (1 violation ISS-2587), push refused, origin/main unchanged
CONTROL A: same scenario with ISS-2587 given audit_grandfathered — push ALLOWED (no false positive)
CONTROL B: push-via-api.js --files monitor/decisions/closed-issues.json in violating state — lint ran inside the script, exit 1, refused before any API call
CONTROL C: push-via-api.js with a non-closed-issues file — lint not invoked (guard scoped correctly)

alternatives_considered: (b) dedicated install-hooks.sh — more LOC, separate file to keep in sync, rejected; (c) Node wrapper around the git-push shell-out — invocation still lives in skippable prompt bash, rejected for the same reason the prompt-level gate failed.
counter_considerations: A hook block converts a silent bypass into a loud push failure mid-decider-run; the decider may then fall into the PROP-050 API fallback — which is why layer 2 (API-path guard) ships in the same PROP. Hook only protects pushes from the decider clone; other writers of closed-issues.json (workspace-sync rescue) are out of scope per directive.
post_deployment_plan: Canary: tinker/operator watch the next 2-3 decider runs. Expected: zero new Mech-A-bypass ISSs from integrity daily audits; decider summaries may legitimately report lint-blocked pushes followed by close-record fixes. A 4th bypass within days means the LLM found a path around both layers — escalate immediately per DIRECTIVE-20260606-001 Step 9.
generalized_by: PROP-081 (2026-06-07): fleet-wide required-artifacts enforcement via shared monitor/scripts/lint-required-artifacts.js. PROP-080 remains the canonical decider-specific implementation; not superseded.
status_note_prop083: PROP-083 (2026-06-07) hardens this gate's hook installation: the original install ran only on clone-creation and was skipped on decider's persistent-clone reuse cycles, allowing 17 post-deploy lint bypasses (ISS-2621). PROP-083 makes the install idempotent and per-cycle in both decider.md prelude and the self-apply block. PROP-080 remains canonical for the filter + gate spec.
